item.name: hard assert
item.run: python3 - <<'PY' import itertools, math, sys import numpy as np TOL_EIG = 1e-9 TOL_ALG = 1e-12 TOL_MPS = 1e-10 S2 = math.sqrt(2.0) Sz = np.diag([1.0, 0.0, -1.0]).astype(complex) Sp = np.array([[0.0, S2, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, S2], [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]], dtype=complex) Sm = Sp.conj().T Sx = 0.5 * (Sp + Sm) Sy = (Sp - Sm) / (2j) I3 = np.eye(3, dtype=complex) def kron_ops(ops): out = ops[0] for op in ops[1:]: out = np.kron(out, op) return out def embed_site(op, site, N): return kron_ops([op if k == site else I3 for k in range(N)]) def I3_embed(N): return np.eye(3 ** N, dtype=complex) def total_two_site_op(A, B, i, j, N): return embed_site(A, i, N) @ embed_site(B, j, N) def aklt_hamiltonian(N, periodic): dim = 3 ** N H = np.zeros((dim, dim), dtype=complex) bonds = [(k, k + 1) for k in range(N - 1)] if periodic and N > 2: bonds.append((N - 1, 0)) for (i, j) in bonds: SS = (total_two_site_op(Sx, Sx, i, j, N) + total_two_site_op(Sy, Sy, i, j, N) + total_two_site_op(Sz, Sz, i, j, N)) SS2 = SS @ SS H += (SS2 + 3.0 * SS + 2.0 * I3_embed(N)) / 6.0 return H def gate_G1(): comm = Sx @ Sy - Sy @ Sx err = np.max(np.abs(comm - 1j * Sz)) return err < TOL_ALG, f"max|[Sx,Sy]-iSz|={err:.3e}" def gate_G2(): S2op = Sx @ Sx + Sy @ Sy + Sz @ Sz err = np.max(np.abs(S2op - 2.0 * I3)) return err < TOL_ALG, f"max|S^2-2I|={err:.3e}" def gate_G3(): SS = np.kron(Sx, Sx) + np.kron(Sy, Sy) + np.kron(Sz, Sz) pi2 = (SS @ SS + 3.0 * SS + 2.0 * np.eye(9, dtype=complex)) / 6.0 idem = np.max(np.abs(pi2 @ pi2 - pi2)) herm = np.max(np.abs(pi2 - pi2.conj().T)) rank = np.linalg.matrix_rank(pi2, tol=1e-9) ok = (idem < TOL_ALG) and (herm < TOL_ALG) and (rank == 3) return ok, f"idem={idem:.2e} herm={herm:.2e} rank={rank}" def gate_G4_G5_G6(N=6): H = aklt_hamiltonian(N, periodic=True) ev = np.linalg.eigvalsh(H) e0, e1 = ev[0], ev[1] gap = e1 - e0 ok = (abs(e0) < TOL_EIG) and (e0 > -TOL_EIG) and (gap > 1e-6) return ok, f"N={N} PBC E0={e0:.3e} E1={e1:.3e} gap={gap:.3e}" def gate_G7(N=4): H = aklt_hamiltonian(N, periodic=False) ev = np.linalg.eigvalsh(H) e0 = ev[0] deg = int(np.sum(np.abs(ev - e0) < 1e-6)) return deg == 4, f"N={N} OBC E0={e0:.3e} deg={deg}" def gate_G8_G9(): Ap = math.sqrt(2.0/3.0) * np.array([[0.0,1.0],[0.0,0.0]], dtype=complex) A0 = (1.0/math.sqrt(3.0)) * np.array([[-1.0,0.0],[0.0,1.0]], dtype=complex) Am = math.sqrt(2.0/3.0) * np.array([[0.0,0.0],[-1.0,0.0]], dtype=complex) T = np.zeros((4,4), dtype=complex) for A in (Ap, A0, Am): T += np.kron(A, A.conj()) mags = np.sort(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(T)))[::-1] cnt = int(np.sum(np.abs(mags - 1.0) < TOL_MPS)) lam2 = mags[cnt] if cnt < len(mags) else 0.0 xi = -1.0/math.log(lam2) if lam2 > 0 else float("inf") xi_pub = 1.0/math.log(3.0) ok = (cnt == 1) and (abs(lam2 - 1.0/3.0) < TOL_MPS) and (abs(xi - xi_pub) < 1e-9) return ok, f"|λ|=1 count={cnt} |λ2|={lam2:.10f} ξ={xi:.10f}" def _expm_i_pi_S(S): w, V = np.linalg.eigh(S) return V @ np.diag(np.exp(1j*math.pi*w)) @ V.conj().T def gate_G10(): Rs = {n: _expm_i_pi_S(S) for n, S in (("x",Sx),("y",Sy),("z",Sz))} sq = {n: np.max(np.abs(R@R - I3)) for n, R in Rs.items()} cm = { "xy": np.max(np.abs(Rs["x"]@Rs["y"] - Rs["y"]@Rs["x"])), "xz": np.max(np.abs(Rs["x"]@Rs["z"] - Rs["z"]@Rs["x"])), "yz": np.max(np.abs(Rs["y"]@Rs["z"] - Rs["z"]@Rs["y"])), } tol = 1e-10 ok = all(e < tol for e in sq.values()) and all(e < tol for e in cm.values()) return ok, f"sq={sq} comm={cm}" def aklt_dispatch() -> int: gates = [ ("G1 spin-1 algebra", gate_G1), ("G2 spin-1 Casimir", gate_G2), ("G3 pi_2 projector", gate_G3), ("G4/G5/G6 PBC spectrum (N=6)", lambda: gate_G4_G5_G6(N=6)), ("G7 OBC degeneracy (N=4)", lambda: gate_G7(N=4)), ("G8/G9 MPS xi = 1/ln(3)", gate_G8_G9), ("G10 hidden Z2 x Z2", gate_G10), ] all_ok = True for label, fn in gates: try: ok, msg = fn() except Exception as e: ok, msg = False, f"EXCEPTION {type(e).__name__}: {e}" mark = "OK " if ok else "FAIL" print(f"[{mark}] {label:<32} {msg}") all_ok = all_ok and ok print("-" * 70) print("all AKLT e2e gates passed" if all_ok else "AKLT E2E FAILURE") return 0 if all_ok else 1 sys.exit(aklt_dispatch()) PY
